svg.text: ECOM Auth Service — Complete User Flow
REGISTER · PASSWORD LOGIN · GOOGLE OAUTH (OPENIDDICT MIMBAN) · AUTHENTICATED REQUESTS
Browser navigates to Google consent screen
Extract sub, email, name from id_token
INSERT INTO AspNetUsers (auto username from email)
Sign final JWT (same claims as authorize step)
Store JWT in localStorage, navigate to /dashboard
ECOM E-Commerce Platform · OpenIddict Mimban Pattern · Confidential Client · JWT Bearer Auth · AspNetIdentity + OpenIddict
